text:
Jared M: Heads up  Customer: MeridianHealth needs SOC2 Type II excerpts + full pen-test report uploaded for their procurement review. They prefer SFTP to our evidence bucket citing internal controls. Can we support SFTP drops, or should we send presigned links? Need short answer for procurement today.

Priya S: Short: we prefer presigned S3 links into redwood-evidence (easier to track + auto-scan). We can offer an SFTP facade but thats a commercial/ops change. For presigned links we can set TTL up to 7d.

CISO-Bot: Security note: hosted accounts cannot import customer-managed CMKs. If they require KMS separation we must move them to Dedicated or Private. For presigned uploads: require SSE-KMS header and metadata tag `classification=confidential`. We will auto-redact PII from diagrams if requested.

Jared M: Procurement asked about egress/evaluation charges: will uploads or scan processing count as billable during the POC?

Priya S: Presigned PUTs are ingress/storage/PUT-request billed normally. For POCs we include a one-off staging allowance (this account: 60GB inbound + 14 days storage). Anything beyond billed at standard rates. I'll confirm the exact bytes for Meridian.

LegalOps: Quick legal bits: pen-test attestation needs an explicit signer (name + role) and scoped period. We have a pen-test-attest-template.docx that the vendor can sign. For full network diagrams we require an NDA + gated data room; we can supply a sanitized diagram without a full NDA. Retention >14 days requires SOW addendum.

Ops: If procurement insists on SFTP we can stand up a temporary SFTP gateway that writes to S3, but ops lead time ~48-72h and request will require ticket + justification. Also note SFTP credentials rotation policy is hourly for upload windows.

Jared M: Customer is pushing for their own KMS for compliance. They want to upload encrypted with their CMK and we just store opaque bytes. Any option?

CISO-Bot: Hosted cannot accept external CMKs. Opaque client-side encryption is possible (they encrypt locally and upload), but that breaks our automated scanning and makes us unable to provide redaction/attestation. If they want server-side with their CMK, that's Dedicated/Private.

Priya S: Suggestion for customer: 1) Use presigned links with our SSE-KMS and mark uploads as `classification=confidential` so we treat files specially; 2) If they must keep key control, perform client-side envelope encryption and share a checksum for verification. Call out trade-offs.

Jared M: Okay. Action items: Priya to confirm exact staging bytes for Meridian account; Ops to confirm SFTP lead time and cost estimate; LegalOps to drop pen-test attestation template + short blurb about retention and NDA; CISO-Bot to provide recommended prefix and scanner tags. Ill draft reply to procurement once we have answers.

Priya S: Confirming I'll post the account-specific bytes here in 30m.

Ops: I'll open the SFTP gateway ticket and post ETA + cost.

LegalOps: Dropping links: pen-test-attest-template.docx (internal), sanitized-network-diagram-example.pdf.

CISO-Bot: Recommended prefix: evidence/meridianhealth/pen-test/YYYYMMDD/ ; required metadata: `classification=confidential`, `scan=pen-test`. Scanner runs within 60m of upload.

Jared M: Great  Thanks everyone, will update procurement this afternoon.
